description.zh: 坐席账号名称（坐席登录名）
description.en: The agent account name (agent logon name).
The acid from the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received.
The callee number for the hotline transfer.
The caller number for the hotline transfer.

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique client request ID for idempotency verification. You can use a UUID to generate this ID.
The connId from the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received.

description.zh: 入呼后，websocket中的holdConnId（ 仅在双步转时传入）
description.en: The holdConnId from the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received. This parameter is required only for dual-step transfers.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the AICCS instance. You can view this ID in the Intelligent Contact Center console.

description.zh: true:单步转，false:双步转，默认单步转
description.en:
Specifies whether to use single-step transfer. Valid values:
- true: Single-step transfer.
- false: Dual-step transfer.

Default value: true.
The jobId from the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received.

The transfer type. Valid values:
- 1: single-step transfer
- 2: dual-step transfer

Default value: 1.
